# Errors

Every error answers with the same body:

```json
{ "error": { "code": "SESSION_NOT_READY", "message": "…", "details": {}, "requestId": "…" } }
```

`code` is stable and meant for programs; `message` is for people and may change. `details` is
optional: it carries extra data of some codes (the issues of a `VALIDATION_ERROR`, the rule of a
`POLICY_BLOCKED`).
`requestId` repeats the `x-request-id` header, so quote it when reporting a problem.

| Code | HTTP status | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 Bad Request | The request does not match the schema of the operation; details holds the issues. |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 Unauthorized | The API key is missing or invalid. |
| `API_KEY_EXPIRED` | 401 Unauthorized | The API key was valid but its expiry date has passed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 Forbidden | The API key is not allowed to use this session. |
| `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE` | 403 Forbidden | The API key lacks the permission scope the operation requires. |
| `IP_NOT_ALLOWED` | 403 Forbidden | The request comes from an address outside the allowed CIDRs of the API key. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 Not Found | The route or the resource does not exist. |
| `CHAT_NOT_FOUND` | 404 Not Found | The session has no chat with that id. |
| `SESSION_ALREADY_EXISTS` | 409 Conflict | A session with that id already exists. |
| `MAX_SESSIONS_REACHED` | 409 Conflict | The number of running sessions has reached MAX_SESSIONS. |
| `SESSION_NOT_READY` | 409 Conflict | The session is not connected to WhatsApp yet; retry when it is ready. A queued send that waits longer than SEND_MAX_WAIT_MS ends with this code. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` | 422 Unprocessable Entity | The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request. |
| `NUMBER_NOT_ON_WHATSAPP` | 422 Unprocessable Entity | The phone number is not registered on WhatsApp. |
| `POLICY_BLOCKED` | 422 Unprocessable Entity | The send policy rejected the message by a rule that has no code of its own; details.rule names the rule. |
| `DUPLICATE_CONTENT` | 422 Unprocessable Entity | The same text was already sent to too many different chats in a short time (rule of the send policy). |
| `RECIPIENT_SUPPRESSED` | 422 Unprocessable Entity | The chat is on the suppression list of the session (rule of the send policy). |
| `RECIPIENT_UNREACHABLE` | 422 Unprocessable Entity | The chat is flagged unreachable, so cold sends to it are rejected (rule of the send policy). |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 Too Many Requests | The API key or the client address sent more than RATE_LIMIT_MAX requests in a minute; wait the seconds in the Retry-After header. |
| `INTERNAL` | 500 Internal Server Error | Unexpected failure of the gateway; the message is hidden in production. |
| `UNKNOWN_OUTCOME` | 502 Bad Gateway | The send timed out after it was dispatched, so whether it reached WhatsApp is unknown; it is never retried automatically. |
| `ACK_ERROR` | 502 Bad Gateway | WhatsApp reported a delivery error (ack -1) for the message. |
| `WHATSAPP_ERROR` | 502 Bad Gateway | WhatsApp Web failed to carry out the operation. |
| `POLICY_DELAY_EXCEEDED` | 504 Gateway Timeout | The send policy kept the message waiting longer than SEND_POLICY_MAX_WAIT_MS, so it was given up. |
| `WHATSAPP_TIMEOUT` | 504 Gateway Timeout | WhatsApp Web did not answer within WA_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS. |

A send accepted asynchronously never answers with its failure: `UNKNOWN_OUTCOME`, `ACK_ERROR`,
`POLICY_DELAY_EXCEEDED` and `SESSION_NOT_READY` reach the consumer as the reason of the
`message_failed` event. The status of the table is what a synchronous send (`wait=true`) answers.
